chunks: And it is narrated: "Its two rocky grounds encompass what the volcanic tracts surround."

key_terms.الْحِرَارُ: the volcanic lands or lava fields
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates a reported transmission
key_terms.لَابَتَيْهَا: its two lava-stone tracts or rocky grounds, referring to the two lava plains of al-Madinah

ai.seo_question: How does the hadith describe the sacred boundaries of al-Madinah?
ai.summary: This hadith refers to the bounded sacred area of al-Madinah, describing it in terms of its two lava plains and the surrounding volcanic tracts. It highlights the recognized geographical limits connected to the sanctity and virtue of the city.
